source.title: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume IV: Distribution of Population by Socio-Economic Characteristics
source.note: Census night 24/25 August 2019. Printed page numbers are given for each table.

verification: Every value in these tables was compared with the text of the KNBS PDF (528 values, no differences) on 29 Oct 2026.
areasNote: KNBS reports Nyamira's five census sub-counties, which are not the four constituencies, and nothing by ward. The county's CIDP 2023-27 (s.1.4.3, p.9) maps them: West Mugirango is Nyamira South; Kitutu Masaba is Manga and Masaba North; North Mugirango is Nyamira North without Kiabonyoru division; Borabu is Borabu sub-county plus Kiabonyoru division.
